table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ItemCategory=(SELECT IC.Name FROM ItemCategory IC WHERE IC.ICatCode = :ai_icatcode),
	Area=(SELECT AR.Name FROM Area AR, Customer C WHERE AR.AreaCode = :ai_areacode AND C.CustCode=S.CustCode AND C.AreaCode=AR.AreaCode),
	Customer = A.Name,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Date = S.Date,
	Qty = SUM(S.Qty),
	Value = SUM(S.Value)
FROM
	Accounts A,
	Item I,
	(SELECT SD.ICode, 
		SL.CustCode, 
		Date = CAST(STR(DATEPART(mm, SL.Date)) +'-01-' +STR(DATEPART(yy, SL.Date)) AS DATETIME),
		Qty = SUM(SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty), 
		Value = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01))
	FROM 
		SaleLedger SL, SaleDetail SD
	WHERE
		SL.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		SL.CustCode IN (SELECT C.CustCode FROM Customer C WHERE C.AreaCode = :ai_areacode) AND
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
		SD.ICode IN (SELECT II.ICode FROM Item II WHERE II.ICatCode = :ai_icatcode)
	GROUP BY
		SD.ICode, SL.CustCode, SL.Date
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		SD.ICode,
		SL.CustCode, 
		Date = CAST(STR(DATEPART(mm, SL.Date)) +'-01-' +STR(DATEPART(yy, SL.Date)) AS DATETIME),
		Qty = -SUM(SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty), 
		Value = -SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01))
	FROM 
		SRLedger SL, SRDetail SD
	WHERE
		SL.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		SL.CustCode IN (SELECT C.CustCode FROM Customer C WHERE C.AreaCode = :ai_areacode) AND
		SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode AND
		SD.ICode IN (SELECT II.ICode FROM Item II WHERE II.ICatCode = :ai_icatcode)
	GROUP BY
		SD.ICode, SL.CustCode, SL.Date) S
WHERE
	I.ICode = S.ICode AND
	A.AccCode = S.CustCode
GROUP BY
	S.CustCode,
	I.ICode,
	I.Name,
	A.AccCode,
	A.Name,
	S.Date
ORDER BY
	Customer,
	ItemName
table.sort: itemcategory A, area A, customer A, itemname A
